claims.text: Rimegepant ODT: 75 mg PO as needed for acute migraine (max 75 mg in 24 hours),
claims.quote: The recommended dose of NURTEC ODT is 75 mg taken orally, as needed. The maximum dose in a 24-hour period is 75 mg.
claims.locator: 2.1 Recommended Dosing for Acute Treatment of Migraine

claims.text: or 75 mg every other day to prevent episodic migraine.
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of NURTEC ODT is 75 mg taken orally every other day
claims.locator: 2.2 Recommended Dosing for Preventive Treatment of Episodic Migraine

claims.text: Ubrogepant: 50 or 100 mg PO; a second dose may be taken at least 2 hours later (max 200 mg in 24 hours).
claims.quote: The recommended dose of UBRELVY is 50 mg or 100 mg taken orally with or without food. If needed, a second dose may be taken at least 2 hours after the initial dose. The maximum dose in a 24-hour period is 200 mg.

claims.text: Ubrogepant is contraindicated with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors;
claims.quote: UBRELVY is contraindicated: With concomitant use of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors

claims.text: with potent P-gp inhibitors, avoid another rimegepant dose within 48 hours.
claims.quote: Avoid another dose of NURTEC ODT within 48 hours when it is concomitantly administered with potent inhibitors of P-gp

claims.text: Rimegepant: serious hypersensitivity (anaphylaxis, dyspnea, rash) can occur, sometimes days after a dose;
claims.quote: Serious hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis, dyspnea , and rash, have occurred in patients treated with NURTEC ODT . Hypersensitivity reactions can occur days after administration, and delayed serious hypersensitivity has occurred.

claims.text: new-onset or worsening hypertension may occur.
claims.quote: Hypertension: New-onset or worsening of pre-existing hypertension may occur.
